dtype: all tensor literals convert once to CPU float32; recipe scalar semantics follow pinned installed torch source
loss_rule: r=(actual-context_center)/context_scale-prediction; mean(max(tau*r,(tau-1)*r)) over B*C*H*3; no mask, all entries finite; center/scale/constants are not trainable
analytic_gradient_rule: dL/dprediction=-tau/N if r>0; (1-tau)/N if r<0; (0.5-tau)/N at exact tie; N=B*C*H*3. Rational analytical expectations are independent cross-checks; installed Torch must agree under original tolerances before Rust is run.
clip_rule: global norm=sqrt(sum_i ||g_i||_2^2) in fixed parameter order; coefficient=min(1,1/(norm+1e-6)); apply one coefficient to all gradients before moments/updates. Diagnostic norm/coefficient are recorded; clipped gradients must meet the existing gradient gates.

optimizer_recipe.name: named_compatible_AdamW_on_Burn_tensor
optimizer_recipe.gradient_missing: error; never silently treat None as zero or skip a parameter

optimizer_cases.analytic_check: moments remain0; all parameters multiply by(1-lr*decay); integer step becomes1 even for explicit zero gradients

optimizer_mathematical_oracle: First clip g globally. t=step_before+1; p_decay=p*(1-lr*wd); m=beta1*m+(1-beta1)*g; v=beta2*v+(1-beta2)*g*g; p_next=p_decay-lr*(m/(1-beta1**t))/(sqrt(v/(1-beta2**t))+eps). High-precision scalar computation is an independent mathematical check, not a replacement for the pinned Torch float32 operation-order reference.

toy_training.scope: miniature artificial train engine; not SmallForecaster or CARE
toy_training.forward: q=x@weight.T+bias; x row-major[1,1,2,2], q[1,1,2,3], target[1,1,2]; toy raw q is a pinball component, not an ordered production forecast API
toy_training.RNG: none; no draws or seed-based parameter initialization
toy_training.Python_reference: one continuous8 trajectory; nine fixed probe outputs at steps0..8

Rust_trajectories.process: second fresh process; commit step4; observe cancellation before step5; no partial update5
third fresh process; read B checkpoint; verify step4/probe before update5, then finish8

toy_training.same_backend_resume_comparison: A versus B/C at every common step; exact parameter/m/v/counter/schedule_next/probe bytes; restore does not import Python values or reference outputs

negative_mutations.I0_wrong_prediction_target_shape: L0 actual becomes[0,0] with shape[1,1,2], prediction remains[1,1,1,3]
negative_mutations.I1_nonfinite_prediction: L0 prediction[0] becomes NaN, represented by an explicit mutation instruction rather than invalid JSON numeric syntax
negative_mutations.I2_nonfinite_target: L0 actual[0] becomes positive infinity via explicit mutation instruction
negative_mutations.I4_missing_named_gradient: O1 omits p.bias gradient entirely; do not replace with0 or partially update p.weight
negative_mutations.I5_duplicate_or_unknown_parameter_name: O1 inserts a second p.weight entry in the ordered input list; reject before conversion to a name map
negative_mutations.K0_truncated_payload: fresh copy of Rust B step4 checkpoint drops the last payload byte, retaining original checkpoint payload hash
negative_mutations.K1_payload_bit_mismatch: fresh copy XORs bit0 of payload byte0, retaining original checkpoint payload hash
negative_mutations.K2_missing_moment: fresh checkpoint omits toy.bias first-moment entry; rebuild hashes/commit for this otherwise well-formed malformed state so identity/completeness must reject it
negative_mutations.K3_duplicate_tensor_name: fresh checkpoint lists toy.weight twice; rebuild manifest/commit hashes; never allow map overwrite
negative_mutations.K4_negative_second_moment: fresh checkpoint sets first toy.weight second-moment value to-1 and recomputes payload/manifest/commit hashes; reject semantic state
negative_mutations.K5_noninteger_step: fresh checkpoint global step is JSON4.5 rather than integer4; recompute manifest/commit hashes; no float-to-integer truncation
negative_mutations.K6_schedule_hash_mismatch: fresh checkpoint schedule hash is64zero hex digits rather than fixed schedule hash; recompute manifest/commit hashes; external expected fixture pin remains unchanged
negative_mutations.K7_missing_commit_marker: fresh copy has valid payload/manifest but no checkpoint commit marker
negative_mutations.F0_before_payload_complete: writer is stopped after half of the intended payload bytes, no commit marker
negative_mutations.F1_payload_fsynced_before_manifest: writer stops after payload fsync, before manifest creation, no commit marker
negative_mutations.F2_manifest_fsynced_before_commit_marker: writer stops after manifest fsync, before exclusive commit marker creation

negative_case_rule: Each invalid/fault case uses fresh files derived before closure. Never mutate old valid or closed checkpoints. Loader must reject and old known-good checkpoint hashes remain unchanged. No additional training updates for negative cases.
reference_freeze_rule: Generate the single pinned-Torch reference and independent analytical/scalar cross-checks before implementing/running Rust acceptance. Save sources, input/recipe/schedule hashes, all expected numeric bytes and closure. Any disagreement stops reference generation; do not loosen tolerances or select a different toy based on Rust results. This specification fixes inputs/rules now, not a successful numerical result.
